Patch 1.2.9

Good morning everyone! With today's maintenance we bring a small set of fixes. Next week's patch will include a new activity and a few other changes, so keep an eye out! We'll be posting a preview before the weekend

  • Glider Image Item Extraction has been added
  • Preparation for activities coming in 1.2.10
  • Human Cannons (on Luxury Liners) are now cheaper to repair, have more HP and only receive siege damage
  • Hero cycles have been added for the next 12 months. A fix has been put in place so months with 5 weeks will have the correct duration. These months are: August 2024, October 2024 and January 2025
  • The recipe for Crest Trade Pack Storage have all properly been moved to the Composition Workbench
  • Wing Flapping Moomoo Armor has been added to the Stablehand shop

== Patch 1.2.9 ==

Good morning everyone! With today's maintenance we bring a small set of fixes.
Next week's patch will include a new activity and a few other changes, so keep an eye out! We'll be posting a preview before the weekend

* Glider Image Item Extraction has been added
* Preparation for activities coming in 1.2.10
* Human Cannons (on Luxury Liners) are now cheaper to repair, have more HP and only receive siege damage
* Hero cycles have been added for the next 12 months. A fix has been put in place so months with 5 weeks will have the correct duration. These months are: August 2024, October 2024 and January 2025
* The recipe for Crest Trade Pack Storage have all properly been moved to the Composition Workbench
* Wing Flapping Moomoo Armor has been added to the Stablehand shop
